newsitem.title: USA: FPL awaits orimulsion ruling in Florida.
newsitem.headline: FPL awaits orimulsion ruling in Florida.

text.p: A Florida appeals court is expected to rule by summer whether FPL Group Inc's Florida Power & Light can burn a controversial Venezuelan fuel known as orimulsion.
Lawyers for the company argued Wednesday before the First District Court of Appeal that it complied with all state and local permit requirements to use the fuel at its Parrish power plant.
Last July, Florida Gov. Lawton Chiles and his cabinet decided that FPL would not be permitted to burn the thick, tar-like fuel because of concerns of environmental damage from any spills.
A lawyer for the state said he expected the court to take at least three months to consider the issues before issuing a decision.
